static_traits.name: Xia Li
static_traits.family_status: Lives with spouse and two children
static_traits.social_status: 有支持性的配偶，但在分享与烹饪相关的Anxiety上存在困难
static_traits.medical_history: without显著躯体疾病；without既往心理问题与治疗史
static_traits.language_features: 表达清晰，能描述情绪与想法，配合度较高；倾向use绝对化/泛化的表达；语速Not mentioned

basic_info.main_problem: 几个月前把一锅意大利面烧糊后，我在烹饪方面持续感到without能与失败；每当想到做饭或尝试新菜时就感到Anxiety并选择回避。
basic_info.core_demands: 持续的自卑感与围绕烹饪的Anxiety已影响日常生活和Family relationships，因此希望获得专业帮助，减少Anxiety、Recovery尝试做饭并改善家庭用餐。
growth_experiences: 几个月前一次将意大利面煮糊的经历被视为重大失败事件：此后来访者将该单次失误泛化为“自己not会做饭”，频繁回避做饭与尝试新菜，Increased anxiety，家庭用餐更多依赖外卖，内心伴随Guilt and self-blame。

core_beliefs: I am incompetent（尤其在厨房/做饭方面）
If I fail at 'basic' matters, I am a failed family member/partner

special_situations.event: At the thought of walking into the kitchen or preparing to cook, recalls the experience of burning pasta a few months ago
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我再做就会再次失败，这会证明我就是without能的
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 回避实际下厨，只看教程与食谱但not动手
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I will definitely mess up again的，还是do not试了

special_situations.event: At family meals, relies more on takeout; notices the family's reaction to changes in meal arrangements
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我not能提供家常饭菜，就等于辜负家人、I am a failure伴侣/Mother
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 继续回避做饭、在心里自责，减少与配偶讨论相关Anxiety

special_situations.event: Thinks of the evaluation standard 'cooking is a basic ability everyone should have'
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果连基本的都做not好，就说明我是彻底的失败者
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 用全有全without的标准评判自己，给自己贴负面标签
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我就是not会做饭的人/我not行

special_situations.event: Preparing to try a new dish or imagining cooking following a recipe
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: One failure means I will always fail in the future
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Prevents oneself from starting by rehearsing failure scenarios, continues to avoid cooking
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Last time it all burned, this time it will surely go wrong too

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be recognized by family, and as a caregiver (the one who cooks) to be competent and worth being needed
core_conflict.fear: 害怕失败与被评判，担心让家人失望、被视为not称职
defense_goal: 通过Avoids cooking来降低暴露于失败与羞耻的风险
Maintains a sense of control over the situation and prevents external criticism through self-blame

object_relations.self_representation: without能且随时会失败的照料者/提供者
object_relations.object_representation: Family/significant others with expectations and judgments

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor encourages her to try simple recipes or discuss concrete action plans
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 若尝试失败，咨询师也会看到我的without能（担心被评判）
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 语气温和、具体化，邀请回到当下情绪体验（例如“此刻你的Anxiety在身体里的感觉是什么？”），减少抽象讨论，采用反映与Clarification。

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When family members or the counselor talk about family meals and cooking responsibilities
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 把压力与not满内收为自责，认为一切是自己的错
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: use接纳与Empathy语言，区分“行为与价值”，肯定努力并探讨现实可行的小步尝试，避免Reinforcement羞耻。

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When recalling the event of burning the pasta and judging oneself by the standard 'everyone should know how to cook'
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Directly internalizes external values and rules as self-standards, finding it hard to accommodate individual differences and the learning process
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 以温和探询的方式松动“应该”规则，use重新框定与例外Questioning，Guidance识do not自我与外界标准的边界。

manifestations: 尽管配偶支持，但难以与其讨论与烹饪相关的Anxiety与羞耻感
在家庭角色期待（提供家常餐食）与自身not确定/Fear之间感到隔离
outcomes: 持续Avoids cooking，导致家庭用餐节律紊乱与外卖依赖

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'.
manifestations: Repeatedly judges oneself by 'cooking is a basic ability everyone should have'
Treats a single mistake as a failure at the moral/worth level

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: Excessively self-blaming on cooking-related topics, believing oneself to have 'let the family down'
Overly cautious about trying new dishes, afraid failure will expose self-worth defects

positive_force: Spouse support, has a basic social support system
Work performance stable，角色功能总体Good
Actively seeks solutions (watches tutorials, reads recipes)
Willing, with counseling support, to try small-step actions starting from simple recipes
negative_force: 全或without思维、过度概括与灾难化Anticipation维持Anxiety与回避
将外界规则Introjection为僵化的“应该”，自我价值与单次表现过度捆绑
Personalization and self-blame stand out, tends to blame family meal problems on oneself
持续Avoids cooking，短期减少Anxiety但长期维持问题循环

target_behavior.core_reason: 一次失败被过度概括为恒常失败，并以全或without标准评价自我价值，害怕再次失败与让家人失望
target_behavior.function: 逃避潜在失败与羞耻、短期降低Anxiety
target_behavior.consequence: 家庭用餐依赖外卖，日常作息受影响，Anxiety与Self-denial被维持

target_behavior.behavior: 在烹饪相关情境出现Significant anxiety与Self-denial言语
antecedent: Being advised to try simple dishes
target_behavior.core_reason: Introjection“应该会做饭”的僵化规则与非黑即白标准，赋予错误过高的自我威胁意义
target_behavior.function: 通过自我批评与Withdrawal获得控制感，避免外界评价
target_behavior.consequence: Impaired self-esteem、Learning与练习的机会减少，形成Anxiety—回避—失败Anticipation的恶性循环
